name: com.nova.modeling
description: A light Blender-style modeler inside the editor (Window > Model Editor): Object / Edit mode, vertex / edge / face selection, G R S with axis lock and typed values, Extrude, Inset, Loop Cut, Bevel, Subdivide, Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Symmetrize, Merge, Fill, Bridge, Shade Smooth, Undo, vertex groups that follow edits, checkpoints. Reference images behind front / side views with a silhouette compare (IoU + per-height width hints + diff image). Character tools: live Mirror and Subdivision modifiers, proportional editing, anime hair clumps and cards, Smart UV, material colors, toon shading with outlines. Rigging: fit a Unity Humanoid skeleton to the mesh (parts found by name), automatic skin weights, spring bone chains for hair strands and skirts with body colliders, pose preview and weight view. Opens FBX / OBJ / glTF (quads kept) and exports FBX, OBJ, GLB (skinned) and VRM 1.0 (humanoid + spring bones + MToon) that the engine turns into an animated, toon-shaded character. Every operation is also a CLI command (nova model <op>) with JSON results and multi-view PNG renders, so an AI agent can model step by step and look at its work.
